zipCodeComparison.neighborhoodsIncluded: Nutley Township Center, Residential & Parkway Districts
keyFindings: Certified composite property tax rate is 2.844%, with an equalization ratio of 78.4%.
Public education represents 52.8% of property taxes, while municipal operations account for 31.4%.
Average residential assessment is $439,040, producing an average annual tax bill of $12,486.3.

keyTakeaways.title: Property Tax Burden & Household Income
keyTakeaways.detail: In Nutley Township, homeowners pay an average of $12,486.3 annually in property taxes, consuming approximately 10.84% of median household income.

keyTakeaways.title: Equalization Ratio & Revaluation Balance
keyTakeaways.detail: With an equalization ratio of 78.4%, assessed values average ~78.4% of current true market values, establishing the basis for certified county tax equalization.

keyTakeaways.title: School District vs Municipal Levy Split
keyTakeaways.detail: Local education represents 52.8% of the total tax bill, municipal government absorbs 31.4%, and Essex County claims 15.8%.
